core_hypothesis: Decomposing dense target sets into sparse depth-based subsets via pseudo-depth estimation improves multi-object tracking in crowded scenes by reducing association ambiguity

pseudo_depth_estimation.definition: Estimate depth from bounding box size using inverse square root of area: depth = 1/sqrt(area)
pseudo_depth_estimation.assumption: Larger bounding boxes correspond to closer objects and vice versa
pseudo_depth_estimation.invariant: Monotonic relationship between bbox size and proximity

hierarchical_decomposition.definition: Partition detections into N depth layers based on pseudo-depth quantiles

layer_wise_association.definition: Associate detections within each depth layer independently, then resolve cross-layer conflicts
layer_wise_association.assumption: Objects within the same depth layer are less likely to occlude each other than across layers

bytetrack_style_high_low_split.definition: Two-stage association: high-score detections first, then low-score detections for unmatched tracks

baseline_methods.SORT: Kalman filter + Hungarian algorithm, single-stage IoU association
baseline_methods.ByteTrack: Two-stage association (high-score then low-score), track creation from high-score only
